1347.1001.1001.description:
Redistribute Static Routes Using OSPF

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies redistribution of static routes into OSPF. Enables static redistribution and confirms the static prefix is advertised as an external/redistributed route on the receiving peer (software and hardware tables) and is reachable by ping; then disables redistribution and confirms the route is withdrawn and connectivity is lost.

1347.1001.1002.description:
Redistribute NO Routes using OSPF

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Negative test: with redistribution into OSPF disabled, confirms that none of the candidate route sources (connected, static, BGP, OSPF/RIP) leak into OSPF on the receiving peer, checking both the software route table and the hardware table.

1347.1001.1003.description:
Checking OSPF redistribution behaviours when the redistribute metric is altered for static routes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the configurable redistribution metric for ospf routes redistributed into OSPF. Confirms the default external metric is applied, then changes the redistribute metric and confirms the new value is reflected in the advertised external LSA / route on the receiving peer.

1347.1001.1004.description:
Checking OSPF redistribution behaviour when the redistribute tag is altered for static routes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the configurable redistribution route tag for static routes redistributed into OSPF. Confirms the default tag, then sets a non-default tag and confirms the new tag is carried on the redistributed external route as seen on the receiving peer.

1347.1001.1005.description:
Checking OSPF redistribution behaviour when the redistribute metric-type is altered for static routes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the configurable OSPF external metric-type for static routes. Confirms the default metric-type (E2) is applied to the redistributed external route, then changes it to E1 and confirms the route type and its metric calculation change accordingly on the receiving peer.

1347.1001.1020.description:
VCS Failover: VMAC off for redistribution into OSPF

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] VCS stacking resilience test for route redistribution into OSPF. Builds a multi-member stack with virtual-MAC (VMAC) disabled, confirms the redistributed routes are present on the receiving peer, then reboots the Active Master to force a failover. Verifies the redistributed routes survive the failover, the running-config stays consistent across all stack members, and the stack cleanly re-forms.

1347.1001.1023.description:
Checking ospf redistribution behaviour with a route-map denying some prefixes

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies route-map filtering of redistribution into OSPF. With a route-map that permits some prefixes and denies others, confirms permitted prefixes are redistributed (present in the route table, hardware table, and pingable) while denied prefixes are not advertised and are unreachable; then removes the route-map and confirms the previously-denied prefixes are redistributed again.

1347.1001.7866.description:
Verify interface description behavior after failover

[Log-derived analysis] VCS stacking config-sync test. Adds interface descriptions across the stack's ports, reboots the stack master to trigger a master failover, and verifies the running-configuration (including the added interface descriptions) is identical across all stack members after the stack re-forms; then cleanly removes the descriptions and confirms the stack returns to a good state.
